## Issue linkage

<!-- Add Refs #N for partial work, or Closes #N only for full resolution. -->

## Resolution

<!-- Describe the implemented resolution, tradeoffs, and any deviations from the Issue. Keep the Issue's specification and decisions current. -->

## Verification

<!-- Record checks actually exercised, their results, failures, and limits. Do not infer completion from unrun checks. -->

## Checklist

- [ ] Linked Issues contain the problem/specification, constraints, alternatives, decision rationale, blockers, and observable acceptance criteria.
- [ ] The resolution and verification address the linked acceptance criteria; remaining work is explicitly tracked.
- [ ] CHANGELOG contains a short user-facing entry with Issue/PR links, or the PR explains why no release entry is needed.
- [ ] Breaking changes link public migration guidance; contracts and affected callers are updated.
- [ ] Public records stand alone without local planning IDs, paths, transcripts, or inaccessible evidence.
- [ ] Applicable validation and correctness/performance gates pass; unsupported or skipped execution is not claimed as coverage.
